svg.title: Walsh template: sixteen pattern questions and the reason for using them

g.title: headline
g.text: 16 binary patterns. 16 coefficients. Less detail, not more evidence.

g.title: subtitle
g.text: Halo's actual reference projection -> pooled cells -> Boolean mask -> signed Walsh spectrum

g.title: patterns-subtitle
g.text: tiny grids: white = +1, black = -1; each W uses the Boolean mask above

g.title: halo-stall
g.text: - flat scores can stall the search

g.title: point-summary
g.text: Different ruler. Not a better truth.

g.title: conclusion-main
g.text: FOR THIS HALO CASE: L2 preserved spatial detail; the coarse Walsh search stalled.

g.title: conclusion-sub
g.text: Use Walsh when binary structure or cheap computation is the point, not because it is magically smarter.

g.title: footer
g.text: Actual Halo mask and coefficients - synthetic geometry only - no learning or encryption involved
